source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.3「無人航空機の飛行原理」

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 飛行機の基本舵はエレベーター=ピッチ、エルロン=ロール、ラダー=ヨーである。
evidence.tested_misconception: 各舵面と回転軸の役割を取り違える。
evidence.reasoning_path: control surface -> controlled axis -> map elevator/aileron/rudder

collision.note: LOW。既存Q061はヘリコプターのスワッシュプレート、Q068はテールローターであり固定翼舵面mappingは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.3 maps elevator/pitch, aileron/roll, and rudder/yaw; no canonical fixed-wing control-surface mapping item exists.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
